metadata_audit.notes_fairness: PLOS retraction notice stated foraminifera type/count were missing; SI Table S17 (p. 220) actually reports broad group (mixed benthics/planktics) and approximate specimen counts (400-4,400) for 17 of 21 samples (4 left blank), though without species-level percentages—and reveals that Cores 64 and 67 mixed benthic and planktic foraminifera in the same AMS targets.

si_figs_s30_s34.note: All four EDS spectra in SI Figs S30-S34 show 92.5-96.5 wt% Ca+C+O (0% Fe/Ni/Cr) with textbook 1-2 um foraminiferal wall pores and radial chamber cross-sections, labeled as 'spherule fragment (interior)'. Moreover, Core 52 (574-579 cm) is dated in SI Table S1 to 9,538 cal BP (Early Holocene, 3,300 yr post-YD).
